name: Portillo's (Buena Park — Near Knott's) Charbroiled Cheeseburger, Grilled Chicken Brioche or Plain All-Beef Hot Dog
brandOrRestaurant: Portillo's Hot Dogs & Italian Beef (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Near Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Flame-broiled burgers, tender grilled chicken breast on brioche, or a plain all-beef Vienna Beef hot dog on a steamed poppy-seed-free bun (request plain bun) with crispy crinkle-cut fries.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Plain All-Beef Hot Dog (no Chicago-style sport peppers, raw onions, relish, or celery salt—ask for a plain steamed bun without poppy seeds) or a Charbroiled Cheeseburger with American/cheddar only and crinkle fries.
watchOuts: Default Chicago-style hot dog comes on a poppy-seed bun with hot sport peppers and raw onions—always order "Plain" on a regular bun; save Portillo's Chocolate Cake Shake for deep remission
